messages:
sam: Quick note — reproducible quota/429 race in async Python client when running 200 concurrent tasks. Many requests still succeed for a short burst after server returns remaining=0.

anya: which commit? any repro code?

sam: `main` after async typing cleanup. Repro: simple asyncio.gather of 200 client.generate calls. Server sends `x-rw-quota: quota=10;window=60;remaining=0`. Client currently uses a shared bucket object and naive flag set which appears racy.

rick: likely two issues: bucket dict insertion race and a non-atomic blocked check. We should protect bucket creation with a small per-client lock and use `asyncio.Lock()` for CAS on remaining/block updates.

anya: alternative: per-request optimistic reservation token via contextvars to keep hot path lock-free, plus corrective update when quota header arrives. Add a strict mode for e2e tests.

infra-bot: CI note — flaky tests in tests/async/test_quota on ubuntu.

sam: plan: tolerant header parser (strip quotes/space), atomic bucket creation, guarded remaining updates, optional RW_STRICT_THROTTLE env var, unit test that fakes headers and asserts no more than N pass after remaining==0. I'll open PR and attach repro example.

anya: i'll review typing changes and mypy. rick: please sanity-check perf impact.

sam: thanks — will also add short docs blurb about header semantics and migration note for limiter behavior change. :thumbsup:
